Chapter 303: Chapter 8 Great Scholar Tai'E: Which Evolution Scholar Are You? (Subscribe Please)_3

Chapter 303: Chapter 8 Great Scholar Tai’e: Which Evolution Scholar are you? (Subscribe please)_3

After all, it’s just a matter of over a month’s time. Lin Yuan could afford the delay.

…

At a far and remote location, there stood a huge research planet.

Great Scholar Tai’e watched the complicated characters flashing quickly on the screen in front of him.

A moment later.

A trace of fatigue appeared on the face of Great Scholar Tai’e.

...

“Let’s see if that question has been answered.”

Deciding to take a break, Great Scholar Tai’e entered the founders’ circle of the Virtual World and opened his chat list with Lin Yuan.

“Seventh Rank?”

Seeing Lin Yuan’s reply brought a smile to the face of Great Scholar Tai’e.

“Hahaha, this time you must be mistaken.”

“Among the multiple evolutionary paths of human civilization, the most crucial stage is undoubtedly the Eighth Layer.”

“To step into the Eighth Layer, one must master the technique of ‘World Opening’.”

“Create a world within oneself.”

“With a world as the foundation, one can continue to ascend; otherwise, it is very difficult to take even one step further with the flesh alone.”

Great Scholar Tai’e wore a proud but somewhat puzzled expression.

He remembered that Lin Yuan should have mastered the rudimentary form of the ‘World Opening’ technique, that perspective of governing myriad paths with a single path; its core was the ‘World Opening’ technique.

If so.

Even if unaware of the ‘World Opening’ technique, one should understand the vast difference between the Eighth and Seventh Rank. How could he still think the Seventh Rank is the most important?

“It shouldn’t be, should it?”

“How could such a mistake be made?”

Great Scholar Tai’e stroked his chin.

“Why the Seventh Rank?”

After some thought, Great Scholar Tai’e didn’t immediately ‘mock’ Lin Yuan. Instead, he sent a message asking for clarification.

…

On Chikun Main Star.

Just as Lin Yuan was preparing to continue his cultivation,

he received another question from the ‘Tai’e’ founder.

“Why the Seventh Rank?”

Lin Yuan blinked.

He believed the Seventh Rank to be the most important based entirely on the Martial Tao Evolution Path.

Because in Lin Yuan’s concept, with Taiyin, Taiyang, Taiji, and the Space Rules, the Seventh Rank Chapter he would create was expected to undergo the greatest transformation. With the enhancement of the Space Rules, the Taiji Domain would evolve into the Taiji Minor World.

That was why Lin Yuan thought the Seventh Rank as the most important.

“To contain myriad paths within a certain path, command myriad paths, integrating with the Space Rules…”

Lin Yuan shared some of the theories of the Martial Tao Evolution Path Seventh Rank Chapter quite casually.

These theories, which Lin Yuan had realized these past days, were meaningless to others, even if revealed. Without Lin Yuan’s foundational research, it would be difficult for outsiders to delve into these theories.

…

At a far and remote location, there stood a huge research planet.

Great Scholar Tai’e patiently waited, staring at the conversation.

He decided that no matter what answer Lin Yuan provided later, he would counter with the technique of World Opening to demonstrate the unquestionable importance of the Eighth Layer.

Ding—

The message arrived.

Great Scholar Tai’e looked at it immediately.

“This?”

Great Scholar Tai’e was somewhat stunned.

All the arguments he had prepared to respond with were suddenly withheld.

Because the message Lin Yuan sent him was a kind of the ‘World Opening’ technique.

However—

How could one use the World Opening technique at the Seventh Rank?

Great Scholar Tai’e couldn’t believe it.

Almost in an instant, Great Scholar Tai’e began to calculate.

Countless characters flickered before his eyes, attempting to prove the possibility of success based on the theories sent by Lin Yuan.

More than an hour later.

Great Scholar Tai’e closed his eyes.

A long time afterward, Great Scholar Tai’e finally opened his eyes.

“It does indeed seem likely to succeed…”

His thoughts collected and his expression solemn, Great Scholar Tai’e replied in the chat box with Lin Yuan:

“Who exactly are you, which evolutionary scholar?”
